correctness.rationale: The six Gram off-diagonals correspond exactly to directions e1,e2,e3,e1-e2,e1-e3,e2-e3. For prime p the cyclotomic minimal polynomial forces each directional residue histogram to be constant; p divides any feasible number of distinct characters, and rank requires at least four. The explicit parity plane (p=2), balanced six-point ternary set (p=3), and nondegenerate line (p>=5) achieve these respective minima. Fourier inversion proves the two binary minimizers. A standalone executable, rerun from its actual accompanying path, exhaustively enumerates all 296010 ternary six-subsets and all 65780 containing zero using exact integers; precisely 27 solutions exist and equal all translations of B0. An independent Gram-coefficient check and translation-orbit comparison confirm its output. The all-prime cutoff is algebraic, not inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: For odd p the smallest rank-three affine simplex has no orthogonal exponential character basis, yet a finite tight redundant Fourier design exists. The result determines precisely the minimum number of distinct additional frequencies for every prime, explains the exceptional small field p=3, and completely classifies all labelled optimum ternary designs as one 27-member orbit. It is a natural minimal Fourier-frame design invariant rather than an arbitrary finite calculation; the complete integer certificate and symbolic all-prime proof address different necessary parts.
